parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the use of this application endpoint on the device.

parameters.name: EndpointId
parameters.description: The Endpoint Identifier for this object as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|section 2.1.2 Application Framework}}. An {{object}} with an {{param}} value of 0 is designated as the device application: This is a special application that is responsible for device operation and contains logic to manage the device's networking and general maintenance features.

object.description: The {{object}} object describes the application endpoint as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|section 2.1.2 Application Framework}}.
